title: Corporate Password Policy
text: All employees must use passwords of at least 12 characters. It is mandatory to change the password every 90 days and use alphanumeric combinations to maintain the security of institutional accounts.

title: IT Onboarding Process
text: Step-by-step guide for configuring computer equipment for new employees. Includes the creation of email accounts, private network access, and delivery of signed hardware.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Mandatory guidelines for working from home. Requires the exclusive use of company-provided equipment and a permanent connection to the corporate VPN throughout the workday.

title: Data Backup Procedure
text: Instructions for configuring automatic weekly backups in the corporate cloud. All critical files must be saved in the designated shared folder and never locally on the desktop.

title: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) Policy
text: Rules for using personal phones for work purposes. It is required to install the mobile device management (MDM) application to access company email.

title: Employee Offboarding Process
text: Steps to follow when a collaborator leaves the organization. Includes the immediate revocation of system access, physical recovery of computer equipment, and mailbox backup.

title: Software Installation Policy
text: The installation of unauthorized or dubious software is strictly prohibited. Any new program must be evaluated and approved through a formal ticket to the technical support department.

title: Security Incident Response Procedure
text: Action protocol in case of malware, virus, or security breach detection. Details how to isolate infected computers from the network and urgently notify the cybersecurity team.

title: Database Access Policy
text: Defines the roles and permissions necessary to access production databases. Only engineering, architecture, and database personnel have write and modification access.

title: Vacation Request Procedure
text: Guide for logging absences and requesting vacation days in the internal Human Resources portal. Requires direct manager approval at least two weeks before the period.

title: System Updates and Patching Policy
text: Servers and end-user equipment must receive mandatory security patches on the first weekend of each month to mitigate vulnerabilities and maintain system stability.

title: IT Expense Reimbursement Process
text: Steps to request reimbursement for minor equipment, peripherals, or cable purchases. Requires attaching a valid tax invoice and having written pre-approval from the area manager.

title: Clear Desk Policy
text: At the end of the workday, employees must lock physical confidential documents away and lock their computer sessions to prevent unauthorized access in the office.

title: VPN Connection Failure
text: The user reports that the VPN client shows connection refused error 412. This was resolved by updating the security client to the latest available version and restarting the computer.

title: Network Printer Offline
text: Report that the second-floor laser printer is not responding to requests. It was verified that the network cable was physically disconnected. It was reconnected and the test page printed.

title: Email Client Sync Issue
text: The user indicates that they have not received new emails since yesterday afternoon. The local application profile was repaired, and the inbox update was forced successfully.

title: Blue Screen of Death on Startup
text: The computer shows a blue screen of death when booting Windows. The problem was caused by a corrupted video driver. The system was restored to a previous checkpoint.

title: User Account Locked Out
text: The user entered their password incorrectly multiple times and locked their Active Directory account. The collaborator's identity was validated by phone, and manual unlocking proceeded.

title: Slow Wi-Fi Connectivity
text: Report of extreme slowness when downloading heavy files in the main boardroom. Device saturation on the access point was detected, and the wireless router was restarted.

title: Software License Assignment Request
text: The design department urgently requests a new image editing software license. Availability was validated, a license from the inventory was assigned, and it was installed remotely.

title: Hard Drive Space Full Alert
text: The monitoring system threw an alert indicating less than 5% free space on the user's main disk. The disk cleanup tool was executed, deleting temporary files and downloads.

title: External Monitor No Signal
text: The laptop user reports that their second monitor is black. The damaged HDMI cable was replaced with a new one from the warehouse, and the extended display was configured correctly.

title: Payroll Application Crashing
text: The administrative system collapses abruptly when attempting to export a monthly report. The application's cache memory was cleared, and the latest compatibility patch was installed.

title: Phishing Email Report
text: A user received a fraudulent email requesting urgent banking data. They were instructed not to open links, the sender domain was blocked at the firewall level, and the email was deleted.

title: Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Unresponsive
text: The director's Bluetooth peripherals stopped working in the middle of a presentation. It was determined that the batteries were completely drained. They were replaced and paired again.

title: Password Manager Usage Policy
text: Employees must store all work credentials in the company-approved password manager. Sharing passwords by email or chat is prohibited, and the master password must follow the corporate password policy.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Policy
text: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, VPN, and cloud applications. Employees must register an authenticator app on their phone during onboarding, and SMS codes are allowed only as a backup method.

title: Acceptable Use Policy
text: Defines the permitted use of company computers, the corporate network, and the internet. Personal streaming, torrent downloads, and visiting malicious websites are prohibited, and network traffic may be monitored by the security team.

title: Email Retention Policy
text: Corporate emails are retained for five years in the cloud archive. Users must not delete messages related to contracts or audits, and each mailbox has a size limit of 50 GB.

title: Incident Escalation Process
text: Defines the support levels for IT tickets. Level 1 help desk handles passwords and peripherals, level 2 handles software and network issues, and level 3 handles servers and security. Tickets not resolved within 8 hours are escalated automatically.

title: Change Management Procedure
text: Any change to production servers, firewall rules, or databases requires a formal change request with a rollback plan. Changes are approved by the change advisory board and executed during the Saturday maintenance window.

title: Asset Inventory Procedure
text: Every laptop, monitor, phone, and peripheral is registered with a unique asset tag in the inventory system. IT performs a physical audit of all computer equipment every six months.

title: Disaster Recovery Plan
text: Steps to restore critical systems after a major outage. Production databases and file servers must be recovered from the latest backup within four hours, and the plan is tested twice a year.

title: Data Classification Policy
text: Company information is classified as public, internal, confidential, or restricted. Confidential files must be encrypted and shared only through the corporate cloud with the correct access permissions.

title: Guest Wi-Fi Access Procedure
text: Visitors receive temporary credentials for the guest wireless network that are valid for 24 hours. The guest network is isolated from the corporate network and internal servers.

title: Printing and Scanning Policy
text: Confidential documents must be printed with secure release using the employee badge. Scanned documents can only be sent to a corporate email address and are deleted from the printer after 24 hours.

title: Lost or Stolen Device Procedure
text: If a company phone or laptop is lost or stolen, the employee must report it to the help desk within one hour. IT remotely locks and wipes the device through the mobile device management console.

title: Cloud Storage Usage Policy
text: Work files must be stored only in the approved corporate cloud. Personal storage services such as personal Dropbox or Google Drive accounts are not allowed for company data.

title: Security Awareness Training Policy
text: All employees must complete the annual cybersecurity training, which includes phishing simulations. Users who fail a phishing test are enrolled in additional training sessions.

title: Help Desk Ticket Process
text: Explains how to open a support ticket through the IT portal or by email. Each ticket must include a description of the problem, screenshots, and the asset tag of the affected equipment.

title: Software License Management Procedure
text: IT tracks all software licenses in the inventory and reassigns unused licenses every quarter. Requests for new licenses require manager approval and budget confirmation.

title: Video Conference Room Usage Guide
text: Instructions for booking and using the boardroom video conference equipment. Users must connect their laptop through the HDMI cable or the wireless display and report any audio problem to the help desk.

title: Authentication Code Not Received
text: The user did not receive the multi-factor authentication code and could not access email. The phone clock was out of sync, and after enabling automatic time the authenticator app generated valid codes again.

title: Ransomware Alert on Laptop
text: The antivirus detected ransomware encrypting files in the user's downloads folder. The laptop was disconnected from the network, the cybersecurity team was notified, and the files were restored from the cloud backup.

title: Shared Folder Access Denied
text: A user from the finance area could not open the shared folder for monthly reports. The user was missing from the security group, and access was granted after manager approval.

title: Laptop Battery Not Charging
text: The laptop battery stayed at 0% even when connected to the charger. The charger cable was damaged, so it was replaced with one from the warehouse and the battery charged normally.

title: VPN Disconnects Frequently
text: The remote user reports that the VPN connection drops every few minutes while working from home. The home router was using an unstable Wi-Fi band, and switching to the 5 GHz network fixed the issue.

title: Mailbox Full Cannot Send Email
text: The user cannot send emails because the mailbox reached its size limit. Old messages were moved to the online archive following the email retention policy.

title: Paper Jam in Office Printer
text: The third-floor printer shows a paper jam error and stopped printing. The stuck paper was removed from the rear tray and the rollers were cleaned.

title: Forgotten Password Reset
text: The user forgot their password after returning from vacation. Their identity was verified with the security questions, and a temporary password was issued with a mandatory change at next login.

title: Malicious Attachment Opened
text: A user opened an invoice attachment from an unknown sender and the computer started running slowly. The device was isolated, a full malware scan was executed, and the user's password was reset.

title: Video Call Audio Not Working
text: In the boardroom, participants could not hear the remote attendees during a video conference. The wrong audio output device was selected, so it was changed to the room speakers.

title: Database Connection Timeout
text: The sales application shows a timeout error when loading customer records. A long-running query was blocking the production database, so it was stopped and the index was rebuilt.

title: New Employee Cannot Log In
text: A new hire could not sign in on their first day. The Active Directory account was created but not activated, so the account was enabled and the onboarding checklist was completed.

title: File Server Disk Space Critical
text: The monitoring system alerted that the file server had less than 2% free space. Old log files were archived to cloud storage and a disk expansion request was opened.

title: Unauthorized Software Detected
text: The inventory scan found an unapproved remote desktop tool installed on a workstation. The software was uninstalled and the user was reminded of the software installation policy.

title: Lost Company Phone
text: An employee reported losing their company phone at the airport. The device was remotely locked and wiped through mobile device management, and a replacement phone was assigned.

title: Windows Security Update Failed
text: The workstation failed to install the monthly security patch and kept restarting. The update cache was cleared and the patch was installed manually.

title: Webcam Not Detected
text: The user's webcam was not detected by the video conference application. The camera privacy setting was disabled in Windows, and enabling it solved the problem.

title: Guest Wi-Fi Not Connecting
text: A visitor could not connect to the guest wireless network in the lobby. The temporary credentials had expired, so new credentials valid for 24 hours were generated.
